verdicts.reason: A breaks up the pill group: TASTINGS sits on its own far below FREE ENTRY and ALL AGES. The date block floats at the top centre, separate from the headline. The missing-asset placeholder is clipped at the right edge. Still, the headline and the RSVP button stand out clearly and nothing collides. B jams 'Sessions' against the bottom edge and sizes RSVP Free the same as the info pills, so the CTA gets lost among them. Its URL sits far from the button, and the tiny legal text is crammed against the missing-asset placeholder in the bottom-right corner.
